name: Preset Deployment
description: Intelligently deploys Azure OpenAI models to optimal regions by analyzing capacity across all available regions. Checks the current region first and shows alternatives if needed.

promptPatterns: \b(quick deploy(ment)?|optimal region|best region|automatic region|fast setup|multi-?region capacity)\b

commands.injectPrompt: Apply the preset skill: deploy the Azure OpenAI model with sensible defaults — check current region capacity first, fall back to the optimal alternative region, and report the chosen location.
